about.title: About Shameem Ahmad
about.subtitle: Professional Russian, Nepali & English Medical Interpreter based in Delhi NCR, India.
about.bio1: Hello, I am Shameem Ahmad. I specialize in medical interpretation and international patient coordination at top hospitals across Delhi NCR (Max, Artemis, Fortis, Apollo, Medanta, and Yatharth).
about.bio2: Having guided hundreds of patients from Russia, Nepal, Turkmenistan, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, and beyond, I ensure language is never a barrier to receiving world-class treatment in India.
about.quote: Health is the key of happiness.
